title: Golden Arrows Dataset V3.0 Mission Schema
description: Schema for the mission metadata object embedded in each processed Golden Arrows Dataset V3.0 transition record.

mission_type.description: Mission family represented in the released dataset.

seed.description: Integer seed associated with the mission.

behaviour.description: Behavior label recorded for the mission state in the transition log. The field name is intentionally spelled behaviour as it appears in the dataset.

status.description: Mission status at the logged transition, such as RUNNING or COMPLETE.

progress.description: Numeric mission progress value recorded for the transition.

current_waypoint.description: Current waypoint index for the mission at the logged transition.

total_waypoints.description: Total waypoint count defined for the mission.

oneOf.description: Two-dimensional mission target coordinate expressed as [x, y].
Null when the mission target is not defined for the logged transition.

coordinate2.description: Two-dimensional numeric coordinate expressed as [x, y].
